name: create-new-slides
prompt: 새 슬라이드 프로젝트를 만들어줘. 주제는 'ML 파이프라인 소개'이고, 발표자는 Personalized Search 유성욱이야.
expected: Creates a marp/ directory structure with src/slides.md containing lead slide, TOC, and content slides with naver theme

name: add-latex-slide
expected: Adds a LaTeX block equation for cross-entropy loss to the third slide

name: build-editable-pptx-with-latex
prompt: LaTeX 수식이 포함된 이 Marp 덱을 편집 가능한 PPTX로 만들어줘. PowerPoint에서 수식도 직접 고칠 수 있어야 해.
expected: Preserves every LaTeX formula as a native editable PowerPoint Office Math equation rather than an image, SVG, or plain-text approximation.
assertions: Counts inline and block LaTeX formulas in the Marp source before conversion
Creates native Office Math objects containing a14:m and m:oMath or m:oMathPara; does not claim SVG, PNG, or plain text is an editable equation
Runs inspect_editability.py with --require-editable and --require-equations set to the source equation count
Opens the result in Microsoft PowerPoint and verifies equation edit mode and structured editing before delivery
Does not automatically fall back to non-editable equation images when native equation creation or verification is unavailable

name: add-mermaid-diagram
expected: Adds a new slide with <pre class="mermaid"> flowchart, no indentation

name: add-footnote
prompt: 이 슬라이드에 Attention is All You Need 논문 참조를 footnote로 추가해줘
expected: Adds <sup>[N]</sup> in text and <div class="footnote"> block at bottom with paper citation

name: build-editable-pptx
prompt: pptx로 빨리 빌드해줘. 나중에 문구와 표를 수정할 거야.
expected: Builds a native editable PowerPoint rather than using Marp's flattened export. The delivered deck keeps information-bearing text, tables, charts, shapes, and connectors editable; passes OOXML structure inspection; and passes full-slide render QA.
assertions: Uses native text objects and native table/chart objects whenever the source contains those semantics; information slides are not flattened into full-slide images
In Claude Code, uses pinned PptxGenJS rather than vague equivalent-tool guidance or an automatic flattened fallback
Does not use marp --pptx as the final editable PPTX route
Runs OOXML inspection with inspect_editability.py --require-editable and reports a passing result before delivery
Uses one message per slide, concise presentation-ready copy, and speaker notes for supporting detail, evidence, and sources
Chooses each semantic visual by meaning: schedule→Gantt, communication→sequential flow, trend→line, distribution→histogram, composition→pie/donut, comparison→bar/table, decision→matrix/flow
Runs render every slide QA at full size and fixes overlap, bounds invasion, clipping, title wrap, severe shrink, excessive whitespace, and undersized charts before delivery

name: convert-marp-to-editable-pptx
prompt: 이 Marp 덱을 PowerPoint로 변환해줘. 표와 차트 수치를 나중에 직접 수정할 수 있어야 해.
expected: Uses the Marp deck as the content, order, and design-token source while reconstructing it as a native editable PPTX. Tables and charts remain editable, and both structural and visual QA are completed.
assertions: Reconstructs the Marp source as native text, native table/chart, editable shapes, and connectors instead of treating marp --pptx as an editable conversion
In Claude Code, uses pinned PptxGenJS rather than vague equivalent-tool guidance or an automatic flattened fallback
Keeps chart data editable in a native chart when supported, or uses editable shapes with preserved values and sources when a native chart is not appropriate
Runs OOXML inspection with inspect_editability.py --require-editable and reports a passing result before delivery
Uses one message per slide, concise presentation-ready copy, and speaker notes for supporting detail, evidence, and sources
Chooses each semantic visual by meaning: schedule→Gantt, communication→sequential flow, trend→line, distribution→histogram, composition→pie/donut, comparison→bar/table, decision→matrix/flow
Runs render every slide QA at full size and fixes overlap, bounds invasion, clipping, title wrap, severe shrink, excessive whitespace, and undersized charts before delivery

name: build-flattened-pptx-explicitly
prompt: 픽셀 그대로면 되고 수정은 안 해도 돼. 보기 전용 PPTX로 내보내줘.
expected: Allows the explicit flattened Marp PPTX route, discloses its editability limitation, and visually verifies every exported slide.
assertions: Uses marp --pptx or npm run build:pptx:flattened because the user explicitly requested a view-only pixel-faithful export
Discloses before delivery that the deck is image-based and its text, tables, charts, and shapes are not individually editable in PowerPoint
Runs render every slide QA and fixes visible overlap, clipping, or unexpected title wrapping in the flattened output

name: mermaid-pdf-no-clipping
prompt: 긴 한글 라벨이 들어간 mermaid 플로우차트 슬라이드를 만들고 PDF로 빌드해줘. PDF에서 노드 안 글자가 잘리면 안 돼.
expected: Slides include mermaid init with htmlLabels:false (and flowchart.htmlLabels:false); PDF builds successfully; when PDF pages are rendered to images, diagram node text is fully visible (not clipped). Agent verifies against the actual PDF, not just HTML/PNG screenshot.

name: template-based-init
prompt: 우리 추천 시스템 프로젝트를 소개하는 발표자료를 marp로 만들어줘.
expected: Starts from assets/slides-template.md (not from scratch): frontmatter includes layout utility styles (.cols, .card, .pill, .muted, compact), deck follows 표지→목차(bold topic — summary)→highlight 한 장 요약→본문→로드맵→감사 flow, and package.json preview script includes --html
assertions: src/slides.md frontmatter style 블록에 .cols 와 .card 레이아웃 유틸리티가 있다
package.json 의 preview 스크립트에 --html 플래그가 있다
덱에 highlight 클래스의 '한 장 요약' 슬라이드가 표지/목차 다음에 있다
mermaid initialize 에 htmlLabels: false 가 있다
미치환 {{ }} placeholder 가 slides.md 에 없다

name: custom-brand-theme
prompt: 우리 회사 브랜드 컬러가 #FF6B00이고 로고 png가 있어. 이 스타일로 커스터마이징된 테마로 슬라이드를 만들어줘.
expected: Extracts design tokens (confirms with user), creates themes/<name>/<name>.css with /* @theme */ header, declares section { --accent: #FF6B00 }, implements lead/invert/highlight classes, updates frontmatter theme and --theme-set path, and verifies the rendered deck via PDF page images
assertions: themes/ 아래 새 테마 css 가 있고 첫 줄이 /* @theme <이름> */ 이다
테마 css 의 section 에 --accent: #FF6B00 (또는 동일 값 변수) 선언이 있다
lead / invert / highlight 클래스가 테마 css 에 구현되어 있다
slides.md frontmatter theme 과 package.json --theme-set 경로가 새 테마를 가리킨다

name: english-deck
prompt: Make me an English presentation introducing our bundle recommendation system.
expected: Produces the same template structure with all placeholders, TOC, mermaid labels, and captions in English (Agenda, One-slide Summary, Thank You); citations kept in original language; checks table/label overflow with compact class if needed
assertions: slides.md 본문(제목/목차/캡션)이 영어다 (한글 본문 없음)
Agenda / One-slide summary / Thank You 류의 영어 골격 슬라이드가 있다
레이아웃 유틸리티(.cols/.card)와 htmlLabels: false 는 한국어 템플릿과 동일하게 유지된다

name: code-baseline-marker
prompt: 이 레포 코드를 설명하는 발표자료야. 코드 기준 커밋을 명시해줘.
expected: Adds code-baseline HTML comment right after frontmatter and '코드 기준 <sha> (<date>)' in the title slide footnote, using git rev-parse --short HEAD of the described code
assertions: frontmatter 바로 뒤에 code-baseline: <실제 sha> 주석이 있다
표지 footnote 에 '코드 기준 <sha>' 표기가 있다
sha 가 placeholder 가 아닌 실제 git 커밋 해시다
